paragraphs: From Mitchelstown test centre in Coolnanave Industrial Park, pull out and take the 1st right onto the Cahir Road
Continue for a short distance to the roundabout and take it straight through, staying on the Cahir Road as you head towards town
After the roundabout take the next left turn, then a quick left again into a residential area heading towards Mitchelstown
Take the 1st right, then when you reach the end of the road you will be asked to pull in for a turnabout
Perform your U-turn safely, checking mirrors and blind spots, then retrace your path with a left and a right back onto the Limerick Road
Turn left onto the Clonmel Road and follow it for roughly 700 metres before taking the next right, still on the Clonmel Road
Take the next left into another housing estate for a second pull-in exercise
After completing the manoeuvre, head back out with a left turn, then a right, followed by another right onto the L1418
Take the next left and pull in again for a further practice exercise, such as a reverse or hill start
When ready, continue on and take the 1st right, then the 2nd right, and at the end of the road turn right
Follow this road turn left and pull in one more time for your final manoeuvre
Move off again and take the next right, then at the end of the road turn right onto the Kildorrery Road
Take the next left onto George's Street, bear right at the continue point
Turn left onto the Limerick Road heading back out of town
To return to the test centre, continue on the Limerick Road to the roundabout and go straight through onto the Cahir Road
Bear slight left off the roundabout take the next left for a final pull-in, then head right back onto the Cahir Road
At the next roundabout, go straight through and follow the road towards New Market Square
Take the right into New Market Square, bear left, then finish with a right onto King Street to complete the route
